<description>
For P2SH inputs, `GetPubKeyFromInput` evaluated the full scriptSig with `EvalScript` and then ran `Solver` on the redeem script, even though only P2SH-P2WPKH is eligible for BIP-352. That costs time on every non-segwit P2SH spend (e.g. multisig), whose scriptSigs can be up to `MAX_SCRIPT_SIZE`.

BIP-141 requires the scriptSig of a P2SH-wrapped witness program to be exactly a single push of the redeem script (`SCRIPT_ERR_WITNESS_MALLEATED_P2SH`). So any valid P2SH-P2WPKH scriptSig is exactly `0x16 OP_0 0x14 <20-byte keyhash>`, and matching that template gives the same result without evaluating anything.

### Benchmarks

`bench_bitcoin -filter='BIP352_GetPubKey_P2SH_.*' -min-time=2000`, Release build.

Before:

|            ns/input |             input/s |    err% |     total | benchmark
|--------------------:|--------------------:|--------:|----------:|:----------
|              688.30 |        1,452,858.07 |    0.1% |      2.20 | `BIP352_GetPubKey_P2SH_Multisig`
|            7,158.19 |          139,700.11 |    0.1% |      2.20 | `BIP352_GetPubKey_P2SH_P2WPKH`

After:

|            ns/input |             input/s |    err% |     total | benchmark
|--------------------:|--------------------:|--------:|----------:|:----------
|               56.87 |       17,584,611.40 |    0.0% |      2.20 | `BIP352_GetPubKey_P2SH_Multisig`
|            6,949.45 |          143,896.18 |    0.0% |      2.20 | `BIP352_GetPubKey_P2SH_P2WPKH`

P2SH multisig is about 12x faster to rule out. P2SH-P2WPKH saves about 200 ns per input; its time is still dominated by `CPubKey::IsFullyValid()`.
</description>
